title: US homeland security department partially shut down after lawmakers fail to agree funding
summary: Lawmakers left Washington for a long weekend without resolving an impasse over much-criticized agency’s funding The Department of Homeland Security has begun a partial shutdown, after funding for the much-criticized agency expired, with a range of services, including domestic flights and the US Coastguard, now vulnerable to disruption. The shutdown was all but confirmed on Thursday, after the Senate failed to clear the 60-vote threshold needed to pass the DHS appropriations bill and lawmakers left Washington for a long weekend without resolving the impasse.
